title: Saved history survives browser reload
result: Passed: the active surface-code research reconnected after a normal browser reload and displayed its saved report.

title: Buffering, split events and server restart
result: Passed with manual reconnection: a local proxy buffered two seconds and split SSE bytes into 37-byte chunks with 5 ms delays. A server restart interrupted the connection; the UI retained the job and reload recovered the metadata-only result.

title: Paper-search mode
result: Passed: the recovered report explicitly says no AI synthesis was requested. The checkbox affects synthesis, not whether papers or citation metadata can be searched.

title: Reading list and research notes
result: Passed: the original CRISPR paper was bookmarked through its paper card and a verification note was saved in the reading list.

title: Evidence extraction matrix
result: Passed for output generation: six BERT-related rows appeared. The BERT benchmark values match its original abstract; missing fields were marked Not stated. Other rows were not exhaustively validated.

title: Keyboard-accessible paper graph
result: Passed: filtering for Attention Is All You Need and pressing Enter on its graph node opened the original paper details. Zero-link results remained visible.

title: BibTeX export
result: Passed: the normal Export menu produced archimedes_3.bib. The downloaded file contained the BERT title, authors, year and paper URL.
detail: The file was opened from the browser download location and its bibliographic fields inspected. Publication version/year conventions still need checking for a final bibliography. Other export formats have automated endpoint coverage; this study does not claim every format was manually downloaded.

title: Manuscript drafting and its limits
result: Output generated, scientific review required: a CRISPR introduction appeared, but one sentence blurred PAM recognition and RNA roles, and missing excerpt details were phrased as absent study work. Instructions were tightened after this observation.

title: Original-paper PDF upload
result: Passed for file parsing and output generation: a 15-page Transformer paper was uploaded through the normal file chooser. The revised output distinguishes excerpt limitations and asks questions about the full paper; scientific accuracy remains unvalidated.
